blurb: Guests can rent brand-new jet skis for guided tours on Assateague Bay, encountering wild horses, dolphins, and coastal scenery. Pontoon boats are available for self-captained cruises with 10-12 guests, exploring wild horse beaches and sandbars. The experience includes views of sunsets and a 50+ square mile riding area on Assateague Bay.
